title.zh: 卷一百八十三 列傳第七十一 何喬新 彭韶 周經 耿裕 倪岳 閔珪 戴珊
title.en: Volume 183 Biographies 71: He Qiaoxin, Peng Shao, Zhou Jing, Geng Yu, Ni Yue, Min Gui, Dai Shan
title.raw: 卷一百八十三 列傳第七十一 何喬新 彭韶 周經 耿裕 倪岳 閔珪 戴珊 Volume 183 Biographies 71: He Qiaoxin, Peng Shao, Zhou Jing, Geng Yu, Ni Yue, Min Gui, Dai Shan

sentences.zh: 何喬新彭韶周經耿裕倪嶽閔珪戴珊

translations.literal: He Qiaoxin, Peng Shao, Zhou Jing, Geng Yu, Ni Yue, Min Gui, Dai Shan
translations.idiomatic: He Qiaoxin, Peng Shao, Zhou Jing, Geng Yu, Ni Yue, Min Gui, and Dai Shan

sentences.zh: 何喬新，字廷秀，江西廣昌人。

translations.literal: He Qiaoxin, styled Tingxiu, was a man of Guangchang in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He Qiaoxin, whose style name was Tingxiu, came from Guangchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 父文淵，永樂十六年進士。

translations.literal: His father Wenyuan passed the jinshi examination in the sixteenth year of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: His father, He Wenyuan, earned his jinshi degree in the sixteenth year of the Yongle reign.

sentences.zh: 授御史，歷按山東、四川。

translations.literal: He was appointed investigating censor and successively toured and inspected Shandong and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating censor and in turn served as touring inspector in Shandong and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙奸民什伽私其知府祿昭妻，懼誅，誣昭反。

translations.literal: At Wumeng the treacherous commoner Shijia took Prefect Lu Zhao's wife in secret; fearing punishment, he falsely accused Zhao of rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: At Wumeng a local villain named Shijia secretly took the wife of Prefect Lu Zhao; fearing execution, he falsely accused Zhao of rebellion.

sentences.zh: 詔發軍討。

translations.literal: An edict ordered troops sent to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued to dispatch an army against him.

sentences.zh: 文淵檄止所調軍，而白其誣。

translations.literal: Wenyuan issued orders halting the mobilized troops and reported that the charge was false.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyuan ordered the mobilized troops halted and reported that the accusation was a fabrication.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年用顧佐薦，賜敕知溫州府。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande, on Gu Zuo's recommendation, he was granted an imperial commission as prefect of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande, on Gu Zuo's recommendation, he received an imperial commission as prefect of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 居六年，治最，增俸賜璽書。

translations.literal: After six years in office his administration ranked highest; his salary was increased and he received a sealed imperial commendation.
translations.idiomatic: After six years in office his administration ranked first; his salary was raised and he was granted a sealed imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 以胡瀅薦，擢刑部右侍郎，督兩淮鹽課。

translations.literal: On Hu Ying's recommendation he was promoted to Vice Minister of Punishments and supervised the salt tax in the two Huai circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On Hu Ying's recommendation he was promoted to Vice Minister of Punishments and put in charge of the salt levy in the two Huai circuits.

sentences.zh: 正統三年，兩議獄不當，與尚書魏源下獄，皆得釋。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong, in two cases he judged prisoners improperly; he and Minister Wei Yuan were imprisoned but both were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhengtong he twice mishandled capital cases; he and Minister Wei Yuan were imprisoned but both were released.

sentences.zh: 朝議征麓川，文淵疏諫曰：「麓川僥外彈丸地，不足煩大兵。

translations.literal: When the court debated campaigning against Luchuan, Wenyuan remonstrated in a memorial, saying: "Luchuan is a tiny land beyond the frontier and not worth troubling a great army.
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated a campaign against Luchuan, Wenyuan remonstrated in a memorial: "Luchuan is a speck of territory beyond the frontier and not worth mobilizing a great army.

sentences.zh: 若遣雲南守將屯金齒，令三司官撫諭之，遠人獲更生，而朝廷免調兵轉餉，策之善者也。」

translations.literal: If we send the Yunnan frontier commander to encamp at Jinzhi and have the three provincial commissioners offer reassuring measures, the distant people will gain renewed life while the court will be spared mobilizing troops and transporting provisions—this is the excellent policy.
translations.idiomatic: If the Yunnan frontier commander is sent to encamp at Jinzhi and the three provincial commissioners are charged to reassure them, the distant peoples will be given new life while the court is spared mobilizing troops and shipping provisions—this is the soundest policy.

sentences.zh: 帝下其議，廷臣多主用兵。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent down his proposal for discussion; most ministers at court favored war.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor circulated his proposal for discussion, but most ministers at court favored military action.

sentences.zh: 於是西南騷動，僅乃克之，而失亡多。

translations.literal: Thereupon the southwest was thrown into turmoil; the campaign barely succeeded, yet losses were heavy.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest was thrown into turmoil; the region was barely subdued, and casualties were heavy.

sentences.zh: 其冬，以疾乞歸。

translations.literal: That winter, on grounds of illness, he requested leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he pleaded illness and asked to retire to his home.

sentences.zh: 景帝即位，起吏部左侍郎，尋進尚書，佐王直理部事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingtai took the throne, Wenyuan was recalled as Left Vice Minister of Personnel and soon advanced to Minister, assisting Wang Zhi in managing the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingtai ascended the throne, Wenyuan was recalled as Left Vice Minister of Personnel and soon promoted to Minister, assisting Wang Zhi in running the ministry.

sentences.zh: 東宮建，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When the Eastern Palace was established, he was given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the Eastern Palace was established, he was given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 災異見，給事中林聰等劾文淵憸邪。

translations.literal: When strange portents appeared, supervising secretaries Lin Cong and others impeached Wenyuan as crafty and vicious.
translations.idiomatic: When omens and portents appeared, supervising secretaries Lin Cong and others impeached Wenyuan as crafty and malicious.

sentences.zh: 左庶子周旋疏言其枉，聰並劾旋。

translations.literal: Left Associate Reader Zhou Xuan submitted a memorial saying he had been wronged; Cong also impeached Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Left Associate Reader Zhou Xuan submitted a memorial declaring him innocent; Cong impeached Xuan as well.

sentences.zh: 御史曹凱復廷爭之，遂與旋俱下獄。

translations.literal: Censor Cao Kai again argued the case at court; consequently both Xuan and Wenyuan were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Cao Kai again contested the matter at court, and both Xuan and Wenyuan were sent to prison.

sentences.zh: 聰疏有「囑內臣」語，太監興安請詰主名。

translations.literal: Cong's memorial contained the phrase "entrusted to inner eunuchs"; eunuch Xing An asked that the person named be identified.
translations.idiomatic: Cong's memorial contained the phrase "entrusted to inner eunuchs"; the eunuch Xing An demanded that the person named be identified.

sentences.zh: 聰不敢堅對，乃釋文淵命致仕。

translations.literal: Cong did not dare stand by his words; Wenyuan was then released and ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Cong did not dare hold to his charge; Wenyuan was released and ordered to retire.

sentences.zh: 英宗復位，削其加官。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong was restored to the throne, Wenyuan's supplementary titles were stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong was restored to the throne, Wenyuan's supplementary titles were stripped away.

sentences.zh: 而景泰中易儲詔書「父有天下傳之子」，語出文淵，或傳朝命逮捕，懼而自縊。

translations.literal: Yet the Jingtai-era edict on changing the heir reading "the father who possesses All-under-Heaven transmits it to his son" had been phrased by Wenyuan; rumor held that an imperial order had been issued for his arrest, and in fear he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Jingtai-era edict on changing the heir—"the father who holds All-under-Heaven transmits it to his son"—had been drafted by Wenyuan; when word spread that the court meant to arrest him, he hanged himself in fear.

sentences.zh: 時喬新已登景泰五年進士，官南京禮部主事，奔喪歸裏。

translations.literal: At the time Qiaoxin had already passed the jinshi in the fifth year of Jingtai and served as a clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of Rites; he hurried home for mourning.
translations.idiomatic: By then Qiaoxin had already passed the jinshi in the fifth year of Jingtai and was serving as a clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of Rites; he hurried home to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 裏人故侍郎揭稽嘗受業文淵，而與喬新兄弟不協，奏文淵死實諸子迫之自經，又逼嫁父所愛妾。

translations.literal: A fellow townsman, former Vice Minister Jie Ji, had once studied under Wenyuan but was on bad terms with Qiaoxin and his brothers; Ji memorialized that Wenyuan's death was in fact compelled suicide by his sons, and that they had forced his favourite concubine to remarry.
translations.idiomatic: A fellow townsman, the former Vice Minister Jie Ji, had once been Wenyuan's student but was at odds with Qiaoxin and his brothers; Ji memorialized that Wenyuan had in truth been driven to hang himself by his sons and that they had forced his favourite concubine to remarry.

sentences.zh: 喬新亦訐稽為巡撫時，嘗薦黃厷，且代草易儲疏。

translations.literal: Qiaoxin also accused Ji that while serving as grand coordinator he had recommended Huang Gong and had ghostwritten the memorial on changing the heir.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin in turn accused Ji of having recommended Huang Gong while serving as grand coordinator and of having ghostwritten the memorial on changing the heir.

sentences.zh: 皆被征比對簿。

translations.literal: Both were summoned for confrontation at court.
translations.idiomatic: Both men were summoned to the capital for confrontation before the magistrates.

sentences.zh: 父妾斷指，為諸郎訟冤，獄得少解。

translations.literal: The father's concubine cut off a finger and appealed for her sons' innocence; the case was somewhat eased.
translations.idiomatic: The father's concubine cut off a finger to plead her stepsons' innocence, and the case was somewhat eased.

sentences.zh: 帝亦以事經赦，釋不問。

translations.literal: The Emperor also held that the matter had been amnestied and released them from further inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor also held that the matter had been covered by an amnesty and released them from further inquiry.

sentences.zh: 已，復丁母憂。

translations.literal: Later he again observed mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服除，改刑部主事，歷廣東司郎中。

translations.literal: When the mourning period ended he was transferred to a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments and rose through the posts to Director of the Guangdong Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended he was transferred to a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments and eventually rose to Director of the Guangdong Bureau.

sentences.zh: 錦衣衛卒犯法，捕治不少貸。

translations.literal: When Brocade Guard soldiers broke the law he arrested and punished them without leniency.
translations.idiomatic: When Brocade Guard soldiers broke the law, he arrested and punished them without leniency.

sentences.zh: 都指揮袁彬有所囑，執不從。

translations.literal: Commander Yuan Bin made requests on someone's behalf, but Qiaoxin refused to comply.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Yuan Bin made requests on someone's behalf, but Qiaoxin would not comply.

sentences.zh: 彬怒，使人捃摭無所得。

translations.literal: Bin was angry and had people search for grounds against him but found none.
translations.idiomatic: Bin was enraged and had people hunt for grounds against him but found none.

sentences.zh: 由是名大起。

translations.literal: Thereby his reputation rose greatly.
translations.idiomatic: From this his reputation rose sharply.

sentences.zh: 成化四年遷福建副使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chenghua he was transferred to Vice Commissioner in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chenghua he was transferred to Vice Commissioner in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 所屬壽寧銀礦，盜采者聚眾千余人，所過剽掠，募兵擊擒其魁。

translations.literal: At Shouning in his jurisdiction were silver mines where illicit miners gathered in a mob of more than a thousand; they plundered wherever they passed; he recruited troops, attacked them, and captured their leaders.
translations.idiomatic: At Shouning in his jurisdiction illicit miners at the silver pits gathered more than a thousand strong and plundered wherever they passed; he raised troops, attacked them, and captured their ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 福寧豪尤氏殺人，出入隨兵甲，拒捕者二十年。

translations.literal: In Funing the powerful You clan had killed men and went about attended by armed followers; those who resisted arrest had done so for twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: In Funing the powerful You clan had committed murder and went about escorted by armed men; they had defied arrest for twenty years.

sentences.zh: 福清薛氏時出諸番互市，事覺，謀作亂。

translations.literal: In Fuqing the Xue clan at times went abroad to trade with various foreign lands; when their activities were discovered they plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In Fuqing the Xue clan at times sailed abroad to trade with foreign ports; when their activities were uncovered they plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 皆捕殺之。

translations.literal: All were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: All were captured and put to death.

sentences.zh: 福安、寧德銀礦久絕，有司責課，民多破產。

translations.literal: Silver mines in Fu'an and Ningde had long been exhausted, yet the local authorities still exacted tax quotas and many people were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: The silver mines in Fu'an and Ningde had long been worked out, yet the local authorities still exacted quotas and many families were ruined.

sentences.zh: 喬新以為言，減三之二。

translations.literal: Qiaoxin spoke on their behalf and the levy was reduced by two thirds.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin spoke on their behalf and the levy was cut by two thirds.

sentences.zh: 興化民自洪武初受牛於官，至是猶歲課其租，奏免之。

translations.literal: Since Hongwu the people of Xinghua had received oxen from the government and even now paid annual rent on them yearly; he memorialized and the rent was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Hongwu reign the people of Xinghua had received oxen from the government and were still paying annual rent on them; he memorialized and the rent was abolished.

sentences.zh: 清流歸化裏介沙縣、將樂間，恃險不供賦，白都御史置歸化縣，其民始奉要束。

translations.literal: Guaihua li in Qingliu lay between Shaxian and Jiangle and relied on difficult terrain to withhold taxes; he reported to the Censor-in-Chief and Guaihua County was established so the people at last submitted to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Guaihua district in Qingliu lay between Shaxian and Jiangle and, trusting the difficult terrain, withheld taxes; he reported to the Censor-in-Chief, Guaihua County was established, and the people at last submitted to the law.

sentences.zh: 遷河南按察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Surveillance Commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Surveillance Commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 歲大饑，故事，振貸迄秋止，喬新曰：「止於秋，謂秋成可仰也，今秋可但已乎？」

translations.literal: In a year of great famine, by precedent relief grain was lent only until autumn ceased; Qiaoxin said, "To stop at autumn assumes the autumn harvest can be relied upon—can we stop at autumn this year alone?
translations.idiomatic: In a year of great famine, by precedent relief grain was lent only until autumn; Qiaoxin said, "To stop at autumn assumes the harvest can be counted on—can we really stop at autumn this year?

sentences.zh: 振至明年麥熟乃止。

translations.literal: Relief continued until the wheat ripened the following year before it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Relief continued until the wheat ripened the following year before it ceased.

sentences.zh: 都御史原傑以招撫流民至南陽，引喬新自助。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yuan Jie came to Nanyang to settle registered wandering people and enlisted Qiaoxin's help.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yuan Jie came to Nanyang to settle displaced people and enlisted Qiaoxin's help.

sentences.zh: 初，項忠驅流民過當，民聞傑至，益竄山谷。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiang Zhong had driven the wanderers away excessively; when they heard Jie was coming they fled further into the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiang Zhong had driven the displaced people away too harshly; when they heard Jie was coming they fled deeper into the mountains.

sentences.zh: 喬新躬往招之，附籍者六萬余戶。

translations.literal: Qiaoxin went in person to summon them; more than sixty thousand households were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin went in person to summon them back; more than sixty thousand households were registered.

sentences.zh: 遷湖廣右布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Right Administration Commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Administration Commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 荊州民苦徭役，驗丁口貧富，列為九等，民便之。

translations.literal: The people of Jingzhou suffered under corvée labour; he verified household registers for wealth and poverty and ranked them in nine grades; the people found this convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jingzhou were crushed by corvée labour; he assessed households by wealth and poverty and ranked them in nine grades, to the people's relief.

sentences.zh: 十六年擢右副都御史，巡撫山西。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed grand coordinator of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 邊地軍民每出塞伐木捕獸，喬新言：「此輩茍遇敵，必輸情求生，皆賊導也。

translations.literal: Border troops and civilians often went beyond the passes to fell timber and hunt; Qiaoxin said, "If these people chance upon the enemy they will surely betray information to save themselves—they are all guides for the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Border troops and civilians often crossed the passes to fell timber and hunt game; Qiaoxin said, "If these people meet the enemy they will surely betray what they know to save themselves—they are all guides for the raiders.

sentences.zh: 宜毋聽闌出，犯者罪守將。」

translations.literal: They should not be allowed to leave the passes; offenders and the defending generals should be punished.
translations.idiomatic: They should not be allowed to slip out of the passes; offenders and the defending generals alike should be punished.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 敵犯塞，偕參將支玉伏兵灰溝營，擊斬甚眾，進左副都御史。

translations.literal: When the enemy raided the frontier he joined Vice Commander Zhi Yu in an ambush at Huigou Camp and killed many; he was advanced to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy raided the frontier he joined Vice Commander Zhi Yu in an ambush at Huigou Camp and killed many of them; he was promoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，奏免雜辦及戶口鹽鈔十之四。

translations.literal: In a year of famine he memorialized exemption from miscellaneous levies and four tenths of the household salt certificates.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine he memorialized exemption from miscellaneous levies and four tenths of the household salt certificates.

sentences.zh: 劾僉事尚敬、劉源稽獄，請敕天下斷獄官，淹半載以上者悉議罪。

translations.literal: He impeached Assistant Commissioners Shang Jing and Liu Yuan for delays in adjudicating cases and requested an imperial order that judicial officers throughout the empire who detained cases for more than half a year should all be penalized.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Assistant Commissioners Shang Jing and Liu Yuan for dragging out trials and asked that an imperial order be issued requiring judicial officers throughout the empire who held cases for more than half a year to be punished.

sentences.zh: 帝稱善，亟從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this and promptly followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised the proposal and promptly approved it.

sentences.zh: 召拜刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the capital and appointed Vice Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 山西大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: Shanxi suffered a great famine and people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi suffered a great famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 命往振，活三十余萬人，還流冗十四萬戶。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go and provide relief, saving more than three hundred thousand lives and returning one hundred forty thousand displaced households.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to go and provide relief, saving more than three hundred thousand lives and restoring one hundred forty thousand displaced households to their registers.

sentences.zh: 還朝，會安寧宣撫使楊友欲奪嫡弟播州宣慰使愛爵，誣愛有異謀。

translations.literal: On returning to court it happened that Pacification Commissioner Yang You of Anning wished to seize the title of Pacification Commissioner of Bozhou from his younger brother of the legitimate line, Ai, and falsely accused Ai of plotting treachery.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to court it happened that Yang You, Pacification Commissioner of Anning, wished to seize the title of Pacification Commissioner of Bozhou from his younger legitimate brother Ai and falsely accused Ai of treasonous designs.

sentences.zh: 喬新往勘，與巡撫劉璋共白愛誣。

translations.literal: Qiaoxin went to investigate and together with Grand Coordinator Liu Zhang jointly reported that Ai had been slandered.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin went to investigate and, together with Grand Coordinator Liu Zhang, reported that Ai had been slandered.

sentences.zh: 友奪官安置他府，播人遂安。

translations.literal: You was stripped of office and resettled in another prefecture; the people of Bozhou were thereafter at peace.
translations.idiomatic: You was stripped of office and resettled in another prefecture, and the people of Bozhou were at last at peace.

sentences.zh: 孝宗嗣位，萬安、劉吉等忌喬新剛正，出為南京刑部尚書。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong succeeded, Wan An and Liu Ji and others, jealous of Qiaoxin's stern integrity, had him sent out as Minister of Punishments at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong succeeded to the throne, Wan An, Liu Ji, and others, resenting Qiaoxin's stern integrity, had him posted out as Minister of Punishments at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 沿江蘆洲率為中官占奪，托言備進奉費，喬新奏還之民。

translations.literal: Reed shoals along the river were mostly seized by eunuchs on the pretext of stocking tribute expenses; Qiaoxin memorialized and they were returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Reed shoals along the river were mostly seized by eunuchs on the pretext of setting aside tribute funds; Qiaoxin memorialized and had them returned to the people.

sentences.zh: 初，喬新之出，中官懷恩不平。

translations.literal: At first when Qiaoxin was sent out, eunuch Huai En was displeased on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiaoxin was first sent away, the eunuch Huai En took the move ill on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 一日以事詣閣言：「新君踐阼，常用正人，胡為出何公？」

translations.literal: One day En visited the Grand Secretariat on business and said, "The new ruler has just ascended the throne and should employ upright men—why was Minister He sent away?
translations.idiomatic: One day he came to the Grand Secretariat on business and said, "The new ruler has just taken the throne and should employ upright men—why was Minister He sent away?

sentences.zh: 安等默然。

translations.literal: Wan An and the rest were silent.
translations.idiomatic: Wan An and the others were silent.

sentences.zh: 既而刑部尚書杜銘罷，群望屬喬新，而吉代安為首輔，終忌之，久不補。

translations.literal: Soon Minister Du Ming was dismissed; the multitude hoped Qiaoxin would succeed him, but Ji replaced An as chief grand secretary and still envied him; the post long went unfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Minister Du Ming was dismissed and everyone expected Qiaoxin to succeed him, but Ji replaced An as chief grand secretary and still envied him; the post long went unfilled.

sentences.zh: 弘治改元，用王恕薦，始召喬新代銘。

translations.literal: When the Hongzhi reign began, on Wang Shu's recommendation Qiaoxin was at last summoned to replace Ming.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hongzhi reign began, on Wang Shu's recommendation Qiaoxin was at last summoned to replace Ming.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「舊制遣官勘事及逮捕，必賫精微批文，赴所在官司驗視乃行。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Under the old system when officials were dispatched to investigate affairs or make arrests they had to carry imperial credentials; only after the local yamen had inspected them on arrival would they act.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Under the old system, when officials were dispatched to investigate or to arrest, they had to carry imperial credentials, and only after the local yamen had inspected them on arrival could they act.

sentences.zh: 近止用駕帖不合符，宜復舊制，以防矯詐。」

translations.literal: Recently only the imperial warrant without the matching tally has been used; the former system should be restored to guard against forgery.
translations.idiomatic: Recently only the imperial warrant has been used without the matching tally; the former system should be restored to guard against forgery.

sentences.zh: 帝立報許。

translations.literal: The Emperor immediately assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor immediately assented.

sentences.zh: 時吉仇正人，頻興大獄，喬新率據法直之。

translations.literal: Ji at this time hated upright men and repeatedly launched great prosecutions; Qiaoxin consistently upheld the law and defended them.
translations.idiomatic: Ji at this time hated upright men and repeatedly launched major prosecutions; Qiaoxin consistently upheld the law and defended them.

sentences.zh: 吉愈銜恨，數摭他事奪俸。

translations.literal: Ji hated him all the more and several times seized on other matters to dock his salary.
translations.idiomatic: Ji resented him all the more and several times seized on other matters to dock his salary.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，京城大水，喬新請恤被災者家，又慮刑獄失平，條上律文當更議者數事，吉悉格不行。

translations.literal: In the second year, summer, great floods struck the capital; Qiaoxin requested relief for disaster-stricken households and, fearing injustice in criminal cases, listed several matters in the statutes that should be reconsidered; Ji blocked them all.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, summer, great floods struck the capital; Qiaoxin asked that disaster-stricken households be relieved and, fearing injustice in the prisons, listed several points in the statutes that should be reconsidered; Ji blocked them all.

sentences.zh: 大理丞闕，御史鄒魯覬遷，而喬新薦郎中魏紳。

translations.literal: The post of Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review was vacant; Censor Zou Lu coveted promotion but Qiaoxin recommended Director Wei Shen.
translations.idiomatic: The post of Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review was vacant; Censor Zou Lu coveted the promotion, but Qiaoxin recommended Director Wei Shen.

sentences.zh: 會喬新外家與鄉人訟，魯即誣喬新受賕曲庇。

translations.literal: When Qiaoxin's wife's family had a lawsuit with a fellow townsman, Lu at once falsely charged that Qiaoxin had taken bribes and shown favouritism.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiaoxin's wife's family became embroiled in a lawsuit with a fellow townsman, Lu at once falsely charged that Qiaoxin had taken bribes and shown favouritism.

sentences.zh: 吉取中旨下其外家詔獄，喬新乃拜疏乞歸。

translations.literal: Ji obtained a rescript from the palace and sent his wife's kin to the imperial prison; Qiaoxin thereupon submitted a memorial begging to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Ji obtained a rescript from the palace and sent his wife's kin to the imperial prison; Qiaoxin thereupon submitted a memorial begging to retire.

sentences.zh: 頃之，窮治無驗，魯坐停俸，喬新亦許致仕。

translations.literal: Before long exhaustive investigation found no evidence; Lu was punished with suspended salary and Qiaoxin was also permitted to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Before long exhaustive investigation found no evidence; Lu was punished with suspended salary, and Qiaoxin was also permitted to retire.

sentences.zh: 喬新性廉介，觀政工部時，嘗使淮西。

translations.literal: By nature Qiaoxin was honest and unyielding; while observing government at the Ministry of Works he was once sent to the Huai west.
translations.idiomatic: By nature Qiaoxin was honest and unyielding; while serving a probationary post at the Ministry of Works he was once sent to the Huai west.

sentences.zh: 巢令閻徽少學於文淵，以金幣饋。

translations.literal: Magistrate Yan Hui of Chao had studied under Wenyuan in his youth and presented gold and silks as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Hui, magistrate of Chao, had studied under Wenyuan in his youth and presented gold and silks as a gift.

sentences.zh: 喬新卻之，閻曰：「以壽吾師耳。」

translations.literal: Qiaoxin refused them; Yan said, "It is to extend your father's years.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin refused them; Yan said, "It is only to wish your father long life.

sentences.zh: 喬新曰：「子欲壽吾親，因他人致之則可，因吾致之則不可。」

translations.literal: Qiaoxin said, "If you wish to extend my parents' years, offering through another is permissible; offering through me is not."
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin said, "If you wish my parents long life, sending gifts through another is permissible; sending them through me is not."

sentences.zh: 卒不受。

translations.literal: In the end he did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 福建市舶中官死，鎮守者分其貲遺三司，喬新獨固辭。

translations.literal: When a eunuch of the Fujian Maritime Trade Supervisorate died, the garrison commander divided his property among the three provincial commissions; Qiaoxin alone firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: When a eunuch of the Fujian Maritime Trade Supervisorate died, the garrison commander divided his property among the three provincial commissions; Qiaoxin alone firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 不得，輸之於庫。

translations.literal: Unable to do otherwise, he paid it into the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to keep it, he paid the sum into the treasury.

sentences.zh: 既家居，楊愛遣使厚致贈，且獻良材可為櫬者，喬新堅卻之。

translations.literal: After he was at home Yang Ai sent envoys with lavish gifts and also presented fine timber suitable for a coffin; Qiaoxin firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: After he had retired home, Yang Ai sent envoys with lavish gifts and also presented fine timber fit for a coffin; Qiaoxin firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 喬新年十一時，侍父京邸。

translations.literal: When Qiaoxin was eleven he attended his father in the capital residence.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiaoxin was eleven he attended his father at the capital residence.

sentences.zh: 修撰周旋過之，喬新方讀《通鑒續編》。

translations.literal: Compiler Zhou Xuan visited; Qiaoxin was reading the Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Zhou Xuan came to visit; Qiaoxin was reading the Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 旋問曰：「書法何如《綱目》？」

translations.literal: Xuan asked, "How does this book's manner of writing compare with the Outline and Details?
translations.idiomatic: Xuan asked, "How does this book's manner of writing compare with the Outline and Details?

sentences.zh: 對曰：「呂文煥降元不書叛，張世傑溺海不書死節，曹彬、包拯之卒不書其官，而紀羲、軒多采怪妄，似未有當也。」

translations.literal: He answered, "It does not record Lü Wenhuai's surrender to the Yuan as rebellion, does not record Zhang Shijie's drowning as death in loyalty, does not record the offices of Cao Bin and Bao Zheng at their deaths, yet the annals and tables draw heavily on strange and absurd matter—this seems hardly fitting."
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "It does not record Lü Wenhuai's surrender to the Yuan as rebellion, does not record Zhang Shijie's drowning as a loyal death, does not record the offices held by Cao Bin and Bao Zheng at their deaths, yet the annals and tables draw heavily on strange and absurd matter—this seems hardly right."

sentences.zh: 旋大驚異。

translations.literal: Xuan was greatly astonished.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan was greatly astonished.

sentences.zh: 比長，博綜群籍，聞異書輒借鈔，積三萬余帙，皆手較讎，著述甚富。

translations.literal: When he grew up he mastered many books; whenever he heard of a rare work he borrowed and copied it, accumulating more than thirty thousand fascicles, all collated by his own hand; his writings were very extensive.
translations.idiomatic: When he grew up he mastered a vast range of books; whenever he heard of a rare work he borrowed and copied it, amassing more than thirty thousand fascicles, all collated by his own hand; his writings were very extensive.

sentences.zh: 與人寡合，氣節友彭韶，學問友邱濬而已。

translations.literal: With others he seldom harmonized; in moral integrity his friend was Peng Shao, in scholarship his friend was Qiu Jun alone.
translations.idiomatic: He seldom found kindred spirits among others; in moral integrity his friend was Peng Shao, and in scholarship his friend was Qiu Jun alone.

sentences.zh: 罷歸後，巡按江西御史陳詮奏：「喬新始終全節，中間只以受親故饋遺之嫌，勒令致仕，進退黯昧，誠為可惜。

translations.literal: After dismissal and return home, the Jiangxi touring censor Chen Quan memorialized: "Qiaoxin preserved his integrity throughout; in the middle he was only forced to retire on suspicion of accepting gifts from relatives and friends—the circumstances of his advancement and withdrawal were obscure, truly a pity.
translations.idiomatic: After he was dismissed and returned home, the Jiangxi touring censor Chen Quan memorialized: "Qiaoxin preserved his integrity from first to last; he was forced to retire only on suspicion of accepting gifts from relatives and friends—the circumstances of his rise and withdrawal were obscure, and it is truly a pity.

sentences.zh: 乞行勘，本官如無疾則行取任用，有疾則加慰勞，以存故舊之恩，全進退之節。」

translations.literal: I beg that an investigation be conducted; if the official has no illness he should be summoned and appointed, if ill he should receive added consolation, so as to preserve the grace owed an old associate and complete the integrity of his advancement and withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that an investigation be carried out; if the official is not ill, he should be summoned and reappointed, and if he is ill, he should receive added consolation, so as to preserve the grace owed an old associate and uphold the integrity of his rise and withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: The request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 後中外多論薦，竟不復起。

translations.literal: Later many within and outside the court recommended him, but in the end he was never recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Later many within and outside the court recommended him, but in the end he was never recalled to office.

sentences.zh: 十五年卒，年七十六。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died, aged seventy-six.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he died, at the age of seventy-six.

sentences.zh: 江西巡撫林俊為彭韶及喬新請謚，吏部覆從之。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Grand Coordinator Lin Jun requested posthumous titles for Peng Shao and Qiaoxin; the Ministry of Personnel reported in assent.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi Grand Coordinator Lin Jun requested posthumous titles for Peng Shao and He Qiaoxin, and the Ministry of Personnel reported its assent.

sentences.zh: 有旨令上喬新致仕之由，給事中吳世忠言：「喬新學行、政事莫不優，忠勤剛介，老而彌篤。

translations.literal: An imperial order instructed that the reasons for Qiaoxin's retirement be submitted; Supervising Secretary Wu Shizhong said: "In learning and conduct, in administration, Qiaoxin was in every way excellent—loyal, diligent, upright, and unyielding, and more steadfast in old age.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial order instructed that the reasons for Qiaoxin's retirement be submitted; Supervising Secretary Wu Shizhong said: "In learning and conduct, and in administration, Qiaoxin was in every respect outstanding—loyal, diligent, upright, and unyielding, and more steadfast in old age.

sentences.zh: 御史鄒魯挾私誣劾，一辭不辨，恬然退歸。

translations.literal: Censor Zou Lu impeached him with private animus; he offered not a word in defense and retired in tranquil acceptance.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zou Lu impeached him out of private animus; Qiaoxin offered not a word in his own defense and retired in tranquil acceptance.

sentences.zh: 杜門著書，人事寡接，士大夫莫不高其行。

translations.literal: Closing his door he wrote books, receiving few visitors; the gentry all esteemed his conduct.
translations.idiomatic: He shut his door and wrote books, receiving few visitors, and the gentry all held his conduct in high esteem.

sentences.zh: 若必考退身之由，疑旌賢之典，則如宋蔣之奇嘗誣奏歐陽修矣，胡纮輩嘗誣奏朱熹矣，未聞以一人私情廢萬世公論也。」

translations.literal: If one must investigate the reasons for his withdrawal and doubt the standard for honoring the worthy, then in the Song Jiang Zhiqi once falsely memorialized against Ouyang Xiu, and Hu Hong and his ilk once falsely memorialized against Zhu Xi—never was a single man's private feelings allowed to overturn the public judgment of ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: If one must investigate the reasons for his withdrawal and cast doubt on the standard for honoring the worthy, then in the Song Jiang Zhiqi once falsely memorialized against Ouyang Xiu, and Hu Hong and his ilk once falsely memorialized against Zhu Xi—never was a single man's private feelings allowed to overturn the public judgment of ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 事竟寢。

translations.literal: The matter in the end was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was ultimately shelved.

sentences.zh: 正德十一年，廣昌知縣張傑復以為言，乃贈太子太保，予蔭。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhengde, Guangchang Magistrate Zhang Jie again raised the matter; thereupon Qiaoxin was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and his heirs granted privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Zhengde, Guangchang Magistrate Zhang Jie raised the matter again, and Qiaoxin was thereupon posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and his heirs granted hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 明年賜謚文肅。

translations.literal: The next year he was granted the posthumous title Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was granted the posthumous title Wensu.

sentences.zh: 喬新五世孫源，萬歷初，為刑部右侍郎，亦有清節。

translations.literal: Qiaoxin's fifth-generation descendant Yuan, at the beginning of Wanli, served as Vice Minister of Punishments and likewise possessed a reputation for clean integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoxin's fifth-generation descendant Yuan, at the beginning of the Wanli reign, served as Vice Minister of Punishments and likewise enjoyed a reputation for clean integrity.

sentences.zh: 彭韶，字鳳儀，莆田人。

translations.literal: Peng Shao, styled Fengyi, was a man of Putian.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Shao, whose style name was Fengyi, came from Putian.

sentences.zh: 天順元年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the first year of Tianshun.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Tianshun.

sentences.zh: 授刑部主事，進員外郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments and promoted to Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments and was promoted to Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 成化二年疏論僉都御史張岐憸邪，宜召王竑、李秉、葉盛，忤旨，下詔獄。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua he memorialized that Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Qi was fawning and depraved and that Wang Hong, Li Bing, and Ye Sheng ought to be recalled; he defied the imperial will and was sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chenghua he memorialized that Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Qi was fawning and depraved and that Wang Hong, Li Bing, and Ye Sheng ought to be recalled; he defied the imperial will and was sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 給事中毛弘等救之，不聽，卒輸贖。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries Mao Hong and others pleaded for him but were not heeded; in the end he paid a fine for redemption.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries Mao Hong and others interceded for him, but the court would not listen, and in the end he paid a fine for redemption.

sentences.zh: 尋遷郎中。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Director.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to the post of Director.

sentences.zh: 錦衣指揮周彧，太后弟也，奏乞武強、武邑民田不及賦額者，籍為閑田。

translations.literal: Commander Zhou Yu of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, the Empress Dowager's younger brother, memorialized asking that civilian land in Wuqiang and Wuyi whose tax quota had not been met be registered as vacant land.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Yu, Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard and younger brother of the Empress Dowager, memorialized asking that civilian land in Wuqiang and Wuyi whose tax quota had not been met be registered as vacant land.

sentences.zh: 命韶偕御史季琮覆勘。

translations.literal: Shao was ordered to join Censor Ji Cong in reinvestigating.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was ordered to join Censor Ji Cong in conducting a reinvestigation.

sentences.zh: 韶等周視徑歸，上疏自劾曰：「真定田，自祖宗時許民墾種，即為恒產，除租賦以勸力農。

translations.literal: Shao and the others toured the area and returned directly; he memorialized impeaching himself: "The land of Zhending, since the time of the founding ancestors, has been permitted to the people for reclamation and planting, and thereby becomes permanent property, with rents and taxes remitted to encourage farming.
translations.idiomatic: Shao and the others toured the area and returned directly; he memorialized impeaching himself: "The land of Zhending has been permitted to the people for reclamation and planting since the time of the founding ancestors, and thereby becomes permanent property, with rents and taxes remitted to encourage farming.

sentences.zh: 功臣、戚裏家與國鹹休，豈當與民爭尺寸地。

translations.literal: Meritorious ministers and imperial kin share weal and woe with the state—how should they compete with the people over an inch of ground?
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious ministers and imperial kin share weal and woe with the state—how should they compete with the people over even an inch of land?

sentences.zh: 臣誠不忍奪小民衣食，附益貴戚，請伏奉使無狀罪。」

translations.literal: Your servant truly cannot bear to strip the common people's food and clothing to enrich noble kin; I beg to submit to the crime of misconduct on this mission.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant truly cannot bear to strip the common people's food and clothing to enrich noble kin; I beg to submit to the crime of misconduct on this mission.

sentences.zh: 疏入，詔以田歸民，而責韶等邀名方命，復下詔獄。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, an edict returned the land to the people but reproached Shao and the others for seeking reputation and defying orders; they were again sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, an edict returned the land to the people but reproached Shao and the others for seeking reputation and defying orders, and they were again sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 言官爭論救，得釋。

translations.literal: Censorial officials disputed and pleaded for them; they were released.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials disputed the matter and pleaded for them, and they were released.

sentences.zh: 當是時，韶與何喬新同官，並有重名，一時稱「何彭」。

translations.literal: At that time Shao and He Qiaoxin served in the same ministry and both enjoyed great renown; together they were called "He-Peng."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shao and He Qiaoxin served in the same ministry and both enjoyed great renown; together they were known as "He-Peng."

sentences.zh: 遷四川副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the post of Vice Commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 安嶽扈氏焚滅劉某家二十一人，定遠曹氏殺其兄一家十二人，所司以為疑獄，久不決。

translations.literal: In Anyue the Hu clan burned the Liu family to death, twenty-one persons; in Dingyuan the Cao clan killed his elder brother's household, twelve persons; the authorities treated these as doubtful cases and long failed to decide them.
translations.idiomatic: In Anyue the Hu clan burned the Liu family to death, twenty-one persons in all; in Dingyuan the Cao clan killed his elder brother's entire household, twelve persons; the authorities treated these as doubtful cases and long failed to reach a decision.

sentences.zh: 韶一訊得實，鹹伏辜。

translations.literal: Shao questioned once and obtained the truth; all submitted to their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Shao questioned the cases once and obtained the truth; all were convicted.

sentences.zh: 進按察使，盡撤境內淫祠。

translations.literal: Promoted to Surveillance Commissioner, he wholly dismantled illicit shrines within his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Surveillance Commissioner, he dismantled all illicit shrines within his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 王府祭葬舊遣內官，公私煩費，奏罷之。

translations.literal: Princely estates had formerly sent eunuchs for sacrificial and funeral rites, troubling both public and private resources with expense; he memorialized and had the practice abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Princely estates had formerly sent eunuchs to conduct sacrificial and funeral rites, burdening both public and private resources with expense; he memorialized and had the practice abolished.

sentences.zh: 雲南鎮守太監錢能進金燈，擾道路，韶劾之，不報。

translations.literal: Supervisory eunuch Qian Neng of Yunnan presented golden lamps as tribute, harassing the roads; Shao impeached him but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Neng, the supervisory eunuch of Yunnan, presented golden lamps as tribute and harassed the roads; Shao impeached him, but no response was made.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，遷廣東左布政使。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year he was transferred to Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year he was transferred to Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 中官奉使紛遝，鎮守顧恒、市舶韋眷、珠池黃福，皆以進奉為名，所至需求，民不勝擾。

translations.literal: Eunuch envoys came in throngs on missions; Garrison Commander Gu Heng, Maritime Trade Supervisor Wei Juan, and Pearl Pond overseer Huang Fu all under the name of tribute demands made exactions wherever they went; the people could not bear the harassment.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch envoys came in throngs on missions; Garrison Commander Gu Heng, Maritime Trade Supervisor Wei Juan, and Pearl Pond overseer Huang Fu all made exactions wherever they went under the name of tribute, and the people could not bear the harassment.

sentences.zh: 韶先後論奏。

translations.literal: Shao memorialized on these matters one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Shao memorialized on these matters one after another.

sentences.zh: 最後，梁芳弟錦衣鎮撫德以廣東其故鄉，歸采禽鳥花木，害尤酷。

translations.literal: Finally, Liang Fang's younger brother De, an Embroidered-Uniform Guard Commandant, because Guangdong was his native place, returned there to collect birds, flowers, and trees—the harm was especially cruel.
translations.idiomatic: Finally, De, Liang Fang's younger brother and an Embroidered-Uniform Guard Commandant, because Guangdong was his native place, returned there to collect birds, flowers, and trees, and the harm was especially severe.

sentences.zh: 韶抗疏極論，語侵芳。

translations.literal: Shao submitted a defiant memorial arguing forcefully; his language implicated Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Shao submitted a defiant memorial arguing forcefully, and his language implicated Fang.

sentences.zh: 芳怒，構於帝，調之貴州。

translations.literal: Fang was enraged, framed the matter before the Emperor, and had Shao transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fang was enraged, framed the matter before the Emperor, and had Shao transferred to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年擢右副都御史，巡撫應天。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，星變，上言：「彗星示災，見於歲暮，遂及正旦。

translations.literal: The next year in the first month there was a celestial anomaly; he memorialized: "The comet portends disaster, appearing at year's end and continuing to New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the first month, there was a celestial anomaly; he memorialized: "The comet portends disaster, appearing at year's end and continuing through New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 歲墓者，天道之終。

translations.literal: The year's end is the completion of Heaven's cycle.
translations.idiomatic: The year's end is the completion of Heaven's cycle.

sentences.zh: 正旦者，歲事之始。

translations.literal: New Year's Day is the beginning of the year's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: New Year's Day is the beginning of the year's affairs.

sentences.zh: 此天心仁愛，欲陛下善始善終也。

translations.literal: This is Heaven's heart of benevolence, desiring that Your Majesty begin well and end well.
translations.idiomatic: This is Heaven's benevolent intent, desiring that Your Majesty begin well and end well.

sentences.zh: 陛下嗣位之初，家禮正，防微周，儉德昭，用人慎。

translations.literal: When Your Majesty first succeeded to the throne, domestic rites were set right, minute precautions were thorough, frugal virtue was manifest, and the employment of men was careful.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty first succeeded to the throne, domestic rites were set right, minute precautions were thorough, frugal virtue was manifest, and the employment of men was careful.

sentences.zh: 乃邇年以來，進奉貴妃，加於嫡後，褒寵其家，幾與先帝後家埒，此正家之道未終也。

translations.literal: Yet in recent years the honored Consort was advanced above the legitimate empress, her family praised and favored nearly on a par with the former emperor's empress's family—this is the way of setting the household right not yet brought to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in recent years the honored consort was advanced above the legitimate empress, her family praised and favored nearly on a par with the former emperor's empress's family—this is the way of setting the household right not yet brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 監局內臣數以萬計，利源兵柄盡以付之，犯法縱奸，一切容貸，此防微之道未終也。

translations.literal: Eunuchs of the supervisory bureaus number in the tens of thousands; sources of profit and military authority are all entrusted to them; breaking law and indulging wrongdoing are everywhere forgiven—this is the way of minute precaution not yet brought to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs of the supervisory bureaus number in the tens of thousands; sources of profit and military authority are all entrusted to them; lawbreaking and indulgence of wrongdoing are everywhere forgiven—this is the way of minute precaution not yet brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 四方鎮守中官，爭獻珍異，動稱敕旨，科擾小民，此持儉之道未終也。

translations.literal: Eunuch garrison commanders throughout the realm vie to present rare treasures, constantly invoking imperial edicts, levying and harassing the common people—this is the way of maintaining frugality not yet brought to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch garrison commanders throughout the realm vie to present rare treasures, constantly invoking imperial edicts, levying exactions and harassing the common people—this is the way of maintaining frugality not yet brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 六卿並加師保，監寺兼領崇階，及予告而歸，廩食輿夫濫加庸鄙。

translations.literal: The six ministers were all given the ranks of tutor and guardian; directors of bureaus concurrently held lofty ranks; when they requested leave and returned home, grain stipends and sedan-chair bearers were lavishly added to vulgar and base men.
translations.idiomatic: The six ministers were all given the ranks of tutor and guardian; directors of bureaus concurrently held lofty ranks; and when they requested leave and returned home, grain stipends and sedan-chair bearers were lavishly granted to vulgar and base men.

sentences.zh: 爵賞一輕，人誰知勸，此用人之道未終也。

translations.literal: Once ranks and rewards are lightly bestowed, who will know encouragement?—this is the way of employing men not yet brought to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Once ranks and rewards are lightly bestowed, who will know what to strive for?—this is the way of employing men not yet brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下慎終如始，天下幸甚。」

translations.literal: May Your Majesty be as careful at the end as at the beginning—the realm would be greatly blessed.
translations.idiomatic: May Your Majesty be as careful at the end as at the beginning—the realm would be greatly blessed.

sentences.zh: 時方召為大理卿，帝得疏不悅，命仍故官巡撫順天、永平二府。

translations.literal: At the time he had just been summoned as Director of the Court of Judicial Review; the Emperor, displeased upon receiving the memorial, ordered him to retain his former office and continue as grand coordinator of Shuntian and Yongping prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he had just been summoned to serve as Director of the Court of Judicial Review; the Emperor, displeased upon receiving the memorial, ordered him to retain his former office and continue as grand coordinator of Shuntian and Yongping prefectures.

sentences.zh: 均大興、宛平、昌平諸縣徭役，劾奏鎮守中官陶弘罪。

translations.literal: He equalized corvée labor in Daxing, Wanping, Changping, and other counties and impeached Garrison Eunuch Tao Hong for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He equalized corvée labor in Daxing, Wanping, Changping, and other counties and impeached Garrison Eunuch Tao Hong for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，代何喬新為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year he replaced He Qiaoxin as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year he replaced He Qiaoxin as Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 故安遠侯柳景贓敗至數千兩，征僅十一。

translations.literal: The former Marquis of Anyuan Liu Jing's corruption reached several thousand taels; only one part in ten was collected.
translations.idiomatic: The former Marquis of Anyuan Liu Jing's corruption amounted to several thousand taels, yet only one part in ten was collected.

sentences.zh: 以其母訴免。

translations.literal: He was exempted because his mother petitioned.
translations.idiomatic: He was exempted because his mother petitioned on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 韶執奏曰：「昔唐宣宗元舅鄭光官租不入，京兆尹韋澳械其莊吏。

translations.literal: Shao firmly memorialized: "Formerly in Tang, Emperor Xuanzong's maternal uncle Zheng Guang failed to pay official rent; Metropolitan Prefect Wei Ao fettered his estate steward.
translations.idiomatic: Shao firmly memorialized: "Formerly in Tang, Emperor Xuanzong's maternal uncle Zheng Guang failed to pay official rent, and Metropolitan Prefect Wei Ao fettered his estate steward.

sentences.zh: 宣宗欲寬之，澳不奉詔。

translations.literal: Xuanzong wished to pardon him, but Ao did not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong wished to pardon him, but Ao did not obey the edict.

sentences.zh: 景無元舅之親，贓非負租之比，獨蒙宥除，是臣等守法愧於澳也。」

translations.literal: Jing is no maternal uncle of the emperor; bribery is not comparable to unpaid rent—yet he alone received pardon and exemption; your servants in upholding the law are shamed before Ao.
translations.idiomatic: Jing is no maternal uncle of the emperor; bribery is not comparable to unpaid rent—yet he alone received pardon and exemption; your servants in upholding the law are shamed before Ao.

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: The memorial was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 御史彭程以論皇壇器下獄，韶疏救，因極陳光祿冗食濫費狀，乃命具歲辦數以聞。

translations.literal: Censor Peng Cheng was imprisoned for discussing the imperial altar vessels; Shao memorialized in his defense and meanwhile argued forcefully about the redundant eating and wasteful expenditure at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the Emperor then ordered yearly provisioning figures to be submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Peng Cheng was imprisoned for discussing the imperial altar vessels; Shao memorialized in his defense and meanwhile argued forcefully about the redundant eating and wasteful expenditure at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the Emperor then ordered yearly provisioning figures to be submitted.

sentences.zh: 荊王見潚有罪，奏上，淹旬不下。

translations.literal: Prince Jing's son Jian Su was guilty; when the memorial was submitted it lingered more than ten days without response.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jing's son Jian Su was guilty; when the memorial was submitted it lingered more than ten days without response.

sentences.zh: 內官王明、苗通、高永殺人，減死遣戍。

translations.literal: Eunuchs Wang Ming, Miao Tong, and Gao Yong murdered men but received reduced sentences of death and were sent to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuchs Wang Ming, Miao Tong, and Gao Yong had murdered men but received reduced sentences of death and were sent to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 昌國公張巒建墳逾制，役軍至數萬。

translations.literal: Duke of Changguo Zhang Luan built a tomb exceeding regulations, employing soldiers numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Luan, Duke of Changguo, built a tomb exceeding regulations, employing soldiers numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 畿內民冒充陵廟戶及勇士旗校，輒免徭役，致見戶不支，流亡日眾。

translations.literal: Within the capital region commoners falsely claimed status as tomb-shrine households or brave militia bannermen and were forthwith exempted from corvée, causing registered households to be unable to sustain burdens and the exiled population to grow daily.
translations.idiomatic: Within the capital region commoners falsely claimed status as tomb-shrine households or brave militia bannermen and were forthwith exempted from corvée, causing registered households to be unable to sustain their burdens and the number of exiles to grow daily.

sentences.zh: 韶皆抗疏極論，但下所司而已。

translations.literal: Shao submitted defiant memorials arguing forcefully on all these matters, but they were merely referred to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Shao submitted defiant memorials arguing forcefully on all these matters, but they were merely referred to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 韶蒞部三年，昌言正色，秉節無私，與王恕及喬新稱三大老，而為貴戚、近習所疾，大學士劉吉亦不之善。

translations.literal: Shao presided over the ministry for three years, speaking forthrightly with stern countenance and holding to integrity without partiality; with Wang Shu and Qiaoxin he was called the Three Elders, yet he was hated by noble kin and palace intimates, and Grand Secretary Liu Ji likewise did not view him favorably.
translations.idiomatic: Shao presided over the ministry for three years, speaking forthrightly with stern countenance and holding to integrity without partiality; with Wang Shu and He Qiaoxin he was called one of the Three Elders, yet he was hated by noble kin and palace intimates, and Grand Secretary Liu Ji likewise did not view him favorably.

sentences.zh: 韶誌不能盡行，連章乞休，乃命乘傳歸。

translations.literal: Shao's will could not be fully carried out; he submitted successive memorials begging to retire and was ordered to return home by post horse.
translations.idiomatic: Shao's will could not be fully carried out; he submitted successive memorials begging to retire and was ordered to return home by post horse.

sentences.zh: 月廩、歲隸如制。

translations.literal: Monthly stipends and yearly attendants were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly stipends and yearly attendants were granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 明年，南京地震，御史宗彜等言韶、喬新、強珍、謝鐸、陳獻章、章懋、彭程俱宜召用，不報。

translations.literal: The next year Nanjing suffered an earthquake; Censor Zong Yi and others said Shao, Qiaoxin, Qiang Zhen, Xie Duo, Chen Xianzhang, Zhang Mao, and Peng Cheng all ought to be summoned and employed; no response.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Nanjing suffered an earthquake; Censor Zong Yi and others said Shao, He Qiaoxin, Qiang Zhen, Xie Duo, Chen Xianzhang, Zhang Mao, and Peng Cheng all ought to be summoned and employed, but no response was made.

sentences.zh: 又明年，卒，年六十六。

translations.literal: The year after he died, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he died, at the age of sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 謚惠安，贈太子少保。

translations.literal: He was posthumously titled Huian and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Huian and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 韶嗜學，公暇手不釋書。

translations.literal: Shao loved learning; in his leisure from public duties his hand never released a book.
translations.idiomatic: Shao loved learning; in his leisure from public duties his hand never left a book.

sentences.zh: 正德初，林俊言韶謚不副行，乞如魏驥、吳訥、葉盛，改謚文。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengde, Lin Jun said Shao's posthumous title did not match his conduct and asked that, as with Wei Ji, Wu Ne, and Ye Sheng, it be changed to Wen.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhengde, Lin Jun said Shao's posthumous title did not match his conduct and asked that, as with Wei Ji, Wu Ne, and Ye Sheng, it be changed to Wen.

sentences.zh: 竟不行。

translations.literal: In the end it was not done.
translations.idiomatic: In the end it was not done.

sentences.zh: 周經，字伯常，刑部尚書瑄子也。

translations.literal: Zhou Jing, styled Bochang, was the son of Minister of Punishments Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Jing, whose style name was Bochang, was the son of Minister of Punishments Xuan.

sentences.zh: 天順四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the fourth year of Tianshun.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of Tianshun.

sentences.zh: 改庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: He was made a Hanlin Bachelor and appointed Reviser.
translations.idiomatic: He was made a Hanlin Bachelor and appointed Reviser.

sentences.zh: 成化中，歷侍讀、中允，侍孝宗於東宮。

translations.literal: During Chenghua he served successively as Reader and Sub-Reader, attending Xiaozong in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chenghua reign he served successively as Reader and Sub-Reader, attending Xiaozong in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 講《文華大訓》，太子起立，閣臣以為勞，議請坐聽。

translations.literal: When lecturing on the Great Instructions of the Literary Glory, the Crown Prince rose to his feet; grand secretaries thought it wearisome and proposed that he be allowed to sit and listen.
translations.idiomatic: When lecturing on the Great Instructions of the Literary Glory, the Crown Prince rose to his feet; the grand secretaries thought it wearisome and proposed that he be allowed to sit and listen.

sentences.zh: 經與諸講官皆不可，乃已。

translations.literal: Jing and the other lecturers all refused; the proposal was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and the other lecturers all refused, and the proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 孝宗立，進太常少卿兼侍讀。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, Jing was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices while retaining his post as Reader.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, Jing was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices while retaining his post as Reader.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年擢禮部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongzhi he was promoted to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongzhi he was promoted to Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 中官請修黃村尼寺，奉祀孝穆太后。

translations.literal: Eunuchs requested to rebuild the Huangcun Buddhist nunnery to enshrine Empress Dowager Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs requested to rebuild the Huangcun Buddhist nunnery to enshrine Empress Dowager Xiaomu.

sentences.zh: 土魯番貢獅子不由甘肅，假道滿剌加，浮海至廣東。

translations.literal: Turpan's tribute of a lion did not come through Gansu but took the route via Malacca, crossing the sea to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan's tribute of a lion did not come through Gansu but took the route via Malacca, crossing the sea to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 經倡議毀其寺，卻貢不與通。

translations.literal: Jing initiated a proposal to destroy the nunnery, reject the tribute, and cease communication.
translations.idiomatic: Jing initiated a proposal to destroy the nunnery, reject the tribute, and cease communication.

sentences.zh: 改吏部，進左侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and promoted to Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and promoted to Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 通政經歷沈祿者，皇后姑婿也。

translations.literal: Secretary of the Office of Transmission Shen Lu was the Empress's aunt's son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Lu, a secretary in the Office of Transmission, was the Empress's aunt's son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 尚書王恕在告，中官傳旨擢祿本司參議。

translations.literal: Minister Wang Shu was on leave; a eunuch transmitted an edict promoting Lu to Vice Director of the Office.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wang Shu was on leave; a eunuch transmitted an edict promoting Lu to Vice Director of the Office.

sentences.zh: 經言非面承旨，又無禦劄，不敢奉詔，復與恕疏爭之。

translations.literal: Jing said he had not received the order in audience and there was no imperial document; he dared not obey the edict, and again joined Shu in memorializing to dispute it.
translations.idiomatic: Jing said he had not received the order in audience and there was no imperial document; he dared not obey the edict, and again joined Shu in memorializing to dispute it.

sentences.zh: 事雖不能止，朝論韙焉。

translations.literal: Though the matter could not be stopped, court opinion approved.
translations.idiomatic: Though the matter could not be stopped, court opinion approved.

sentences.zh: 靈壽奸民獻地於中官李廣，戶部持不得。

translations.literal: A rascal of Lingshou offered land to eunuch Li Guang; the Ministry of Revenue held that it could not be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: A rascal of Lingshou offered land to the eunuch Li Guang; the Ministry of Revenue held that it could not be accepted.

sentences.zh: 經倡九卿疏爭，卒罪獻地者。

translations.literal: Jing initiated a memorial dispute among the nine ministers; in the end the land-offerer was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Jing initiated a memorial dispute among the nine ministers, and in the end the man who offered the land was punished.

sentences.zh: 嘗上言：「外戚家無功求遷，無勞乞賞，兼齋醮遊宴，濫費無紀，致帑藏殫虛，宜大為撙節。

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "Imperial affinal families seek promotion without merit and beg rewards without service; together with Daoist rites and banquets, their wasteful expenditure knows no bounds, draining the treasury to emptiness—great economy should be exercised.
translations.idiomatic: He once memorialized: "Imperial affinal families seek promotion without merit and beg rewards without service; together with Daoist rites and banquets, their wasteful expenditure knows no bounds, draining the treasury to emptiness—great economy should be exercised.

sentences.zh: 近例，預備倉積粟多者，守令賜誥敕，不次遷官，遂致剝下幹進。

translations.literal: Under recent precedent, magistrates whose reserve granaries held much grain were granted edicts of commendation and irregular promotion, thereby causing the exploitation of inferiors for advancement-seeking.
translations.idiomatic: Under recent precedent, magistrates whose reserve granaries held much grain were granted edicts of commendation and irregular promotion, thereby causing the exploitation of inferiors for advancement-seeking.

sentences.zh: 請如洪武間例，悉出官帑平糴，毋奪民財，考績毋專以積粟為能。

translations.literal: I ask that, following the Hongwu precedent, grain be sold at fair price entirely from official funds, without seizing the people's wealth, and that merit evaluation not focus solely on accumulated grain.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that, following the Hongwu precedent, grain be sold at fair price entirely from official funds, without seizing the people's wealth, and that merit evaluation not focus solely on accumulated grain.

sentences.zh: 至清軍之弊，洪熙以前在旗校，宣德以後在裏胥。

translations.literal: As for the abuses of military household registration review, before Hongxi the fault lay with banner officers; after Xuande it lay with village clerks.
translations.idiomatic: As for the abuses of military household registration review, before Hongxi the fault lay with banner officers; after Xuande it lay with village clerks.

sentences.zh: 弊在旗校者，版籍猶存，若裏胥則並版籍而淆亂之，宜考故冊洗奸弊。

translations.literal: When the fault lay with banner officers, the registers still survived; when it lies with village clerks they muddle the registers together—old books should be consulted to purge corruption.
translations.idiomatic: When the fault lay with banner officers, the registers still survived; when it lies with village clerks they muddle the registers together—old books should be consulted to purge corruption.

sentences.zh: 災傷民，乞省恤。

translations.literal: When disaster harms the people, I beg that expenditures be reduced and the people relieved.
translations.idiomatic: When disaster harms the people, I beg that expenditures be reduced and the people relieved.

sentences.zh: 惜薪司薪炭約支數年，災荒郡縣，宜盡與停免。

translations.literal: The Firewood Bureau's fuel and charcoal are estimated to last several years; in disaster-stricken counties and prefectures, they should all be stopped and exempted.
translations.idiomatic: The Firewood Bureau's fuel and charcoal are estimated to last several years; in disaster-stricken counties and prefectures, collection of these levies should be halted and remitted entirely.

sentences.zh: 四方顏料雜辦亦然。

translations.literal: Pigments and miscellaneous supplies collected from the four directions should be treated the same way.
translations.idiomatic: The same should apply to pigments and miscellaneous supplies collected from the four directions.

sentences.zh: 此救民急務也。」

translations.literal: This is an urgent task for saving the people.
translations.idiomatic: This is an urgent matter for relieving the people.

sentences.zh: 帝多采納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor largely adopted his recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor largely adopted his recommendations.

sentences.zh: 八年，文武大臣以災異陳時政，經為具奏草，而斥戲樂一事，語尤切直。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, civil and military grandees addressed current affairs in light of portents; Jing drafted the memorial, and his words on rejecting theatrical entertainment were especially cutting and direct.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, civil and military grandees addressed current affairs in light of portents; Zhou Jing drafted the memorial, and his words on rejecting theatrical entertainment were especially cutting and direct.

sentences.zh: 帝密令中官廉草奏者，尚書耿裕曰：「疏首吏部，裕實具草。」

translations.literal: The Emperor secretly ordered a eunuch to investigate who had drafted the memorial; Minister Geng Yu said: "The memorial was headed by the Ministry of Personnel, but Yu actually drafted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor secretly ordered a eunuch to investigate who had drafted the memorial; Minister Geng Yu said, "The memorial was headed by the Ministry of Personnel, but I actually drafted it.

sentences.zh: 經曰：「疏草出經手，即有罪，罪經。」

translations.literal: Jing said: "The draft passed through Jing's hand; if there is guilt, let Jing bear it."
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Jing said, "The draft passed through my hand; if there is guilt, let me bear it."

sentences.zh: 世兩賢之。

translations.literal: Later ages praised both men.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages praised both men.

sentences.zh: 明年，代葉淇為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: The next year he replaced Ye Qi as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he replaced Ye Qi as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 時孝宗寬仁，而戶部尤奸蠹所萃，挾勢行私者不可勝紀。

translations.literal: At the time the Hongzhi Emperor was lenient and benevolent, but the Ministry of Revenue especially gathered cheats and parasites; those who wielded power for private ends were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Hongzhi Emperor was lenient and benevolent, but the Ministry of Revenue especially gathered cheats and parasites, and those who wielded power for private ends were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 少不如意，讒毀隨之。

translations.literal: At the slightest dissatisfaction, slander and vilification followed.
translations.idiomatic: At the slightest dissatisfaction, slander and vilification followed.

sentences.zh: 經悉按祖宗成憲，無所顧。

translations.literal: Jing adhered entirely to the established statutes of the founding emperors, without regard for consequences.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Jing adhered entirely to the established statutes of the founding emperors, without regard for consequences.

sentences.zh: 寬逋緩征，裁節冗濫。

translations.literal: He eased arrears and slowed collections, and trimmed redundant and wasteful spending.
translations.idiomatic: He eased arrears and slowed collections, and trimmed redundant and wasteful spending.

sentences.zh: 四方告災，必覆奏蠲除。

translations.literal: When the four directions reported disasters, he always memorialized again requesting remission.
translations.idiomatic: When the four directions reported disasters, he always memorialized again requesting remission.

sentences.zh: 每委官監稅課，入多者與下考，苛切之風為之少衰。

translations.literal: Whenever officials were dispatched to supervise tax collection, those who brought in much received poor evaluations; the harsh and exacting mood thereby abated somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever officials were dispatched to supervise tax collection, those who brought in large revenues received poor evaluations, and the harsh and exacting mood thereby abated somewhat.

sentences.zh: 奉禦趙瑄獻雄縣地為東宮莊。

translations.literal: Attendant Zhao Xuan presented land in Xiong County as an Eastern Palace estate.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Zhao Xuan presented land in Xiong County as an Eastern Palace estate.

sentences.zh: 經等劾瑄違制，下詔獄。

translations.literal: Jing and others impeached Xuan for violating regulations and had him sent to the edict prison.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Jing and others impeached Xuan for violating regulations and had him sent to the edict prison.

sentences.zh: 而帝復從鎮撫司言遣官勘實。

translations.literal: But the Emperor again followed the Brocade Guard's advice and dispatched officials to investigate on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: But the Emperor again followed the Brocade Guard's advice and dispatched officials to investigate on the ground.

sentences.zh: 經等復爭之曰：「太祖、太宗定制，閑田任民開墾。

translations.literal: Jing and others remonstrated again: "The Taizu and Taizong established the rule that idle land should be left to the people to open and cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Jing and others remonstrated again: "The Taizu and Taizong established the rule that idle land should be left to the people to open and cultivate.

sentences.zh: 若因奸人言而籍之官，是土田予奪，盡出奸人口，小民無以為生矣。」

translations.literal: If land is registered to the state because scoundrels speak, then the granting and taking of fields would all come from scoundrels' mouths, and common folk would have no means to live.
translations.idiomatic: If land is registered to the state because scoundrels speak, then the granting and taking of fields would all come from scoundrels' mouths, and common folk would have no means to live.

sentences.zh: 既而勘者及巡撫高銓言閑田止七十頃，悉與民田錯。

translations.literal: Thereupon the investigators and Grand Coordinator Gao Quan reported that idle land amounted to only seventy qing, all intermingled with commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the investigators and Grand Coordinator Gao Quan reported that idle land amounted to only seventy qing, all intermingled with commoners' fields.

sentences.zh: 於是從經言仍賦之民，治瑄罪。

translations.literal: Thereupon, following Jing's argument, the land was still taxed to the people, and Xuan was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, following Zhou Jing's argument, the land was still taxed to the people, and Xuan was punished.

sentences.zh: 中官何鼎劾外戚張鶴齡下獄，經疏救之，忤旨切責。

translations.literal: Eunuch He Ding impeached maternal kinsman Zhang Heling and had him imprisoned; Jing memorialized in his defense and was sharply rebuked for defying the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch He Ding impeached maternal kinsman Zhang Heling and had him imprisoned; Zhou Jing memorialized in his defense and was sharply rebuked for defying the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 雍王祐枟乞衡州稅課司及衡陽縣河泊所，經言不可許。

translations.literal: Prince Yong You Bin requested the Hengzhou Tax Office and the Hengyang County River Port Office; Jing said this could not be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yong You Bin requested the Hengzhou Tax Office and the Hengyang County River Port Office; Zhou Jing said this could not be granted.

sentences.zh: 帝納之，命自今四方稅課，王府不得請。

translations.literal: The Emperor accepted this and ordered that from then on revenue from the four directions could not be requested by princely establishments.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted this and ordered that from then on revenue from the four directions could not be requested by princely establishments.

sentences.zh: 中官織造者，請增給兩浙鹽課二萬引，經等言：「鹽筴佐邊，不宜濫給。

translations.literal: The palace weaving eunuchs requested an additional twenty thousand salt certificates from the Two Zhes; Jing and others said: "Salt revenue assists the frontier; it should not be lavishly granted.
translations.idiomatic: The palace weaving eunuchs requested an additional twenty thousand salt certificates from the Two Zhes; Zhou Jing and others said, "Salt revenue assists the frontier; it should not be lavishly granted.

sentences.zh: 且祖宗朝織染諸局供禦有常數，若曰取用有加，則江南、兩浙已例外增造，若曰工匠不足，則仰食公家不下千余人，所為何事。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the ancestral reigns the weaving and dyeing bureaus had fixed quotas for imperial supply; if one says usage has increased, Jiangnan and the Two Zhes have already been producing beyond quota; if one says craftsmen are insufficient, those living off the public purse number no fewer than a thousand—what are they doing?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in the ancestral reigns the weaving and dyeing bureaus had fixed quotas for imperial supply; if one says usage has increased, Jiangnan and the Two Zhes have already been producing beyond quota; if one says craftsmen are insufficient, those living off the public purse number no fewer than a thousand—what are they doing?

sentences.zh: 是知供用未必缺，而徒導陛下以勞民傷財之事也。」

translations.literal: This shows supplies are not necessarily lacking, and they are merely leading Your Majesty toward affairs that tire the people and waste treasure.
translations.idiomatic: This shows supplies are not necessarily lacking, and they are merely leading Your Majesty toward affairs that tire the people and waste the treasury.

sentences.zh: 帝不從。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor did not agree.

sentences.zh: 經恐歲以為常，再疏請斷其後，乃命歲予五千引。

translations.literal: Jing feared this would become an annual custom and memorialized again asking to cut it off thereafter; he was then ordered to grant five thousand certificates yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Jing feared this would become an annual custom and memorialized again asking to cut it off thereafter; the Emperor then ordered five thousand certificates granted yearly.

sentences.zh: 先是，倉場監督內官依成化末年例裁減。

translations.literal: Earlier, the supervising eunuchs at the granaries had been reduced according to the precedent of the late Chenghua reign.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the supervising eunuchs at the granaries had been reduced according to the precedent of the late Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，帝復增用少監莫英等三人。
